I’m checking the view’s status inputs and confirmation cleanup paths now.

item.text:
I traced the failure to [src/user/email.js](/app/src/user/email.js:27). It stores only `confirm:<code>` with a database expiry, so there is no user ID lookup or explicit timestamp for determining whether validation is pending or expired. The ACP actions in [src/socket.io/admin/user.js](/app/src/socket.io/admin/user.js:68) use the profile email, which fails when that field is empty. The [user list](/app/src/views/admin/manage/users.tpl:110) shows only a binary confirmed indicator, and [account deletion](/app/src/user/delete.js:113) has no confirmation key cleanup.

The fix needs to create and clean up both required keys, retain enough confirmation data to distinguish **Validation Expired** from **(no email)**, fall back to the pending email for ACP actions, and derive all four statuses for the view. I also found a likely independent defect: `confirmByCode` calls `setUserField` without a uid at [line 119](/app/src/user/email.js:119). Existing tests cover basic confirmation but not these expiry and missing email cases.

I updated [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). I did not edit project source or tests because this pass was restricted to fault localization; the issue remains unresolved.
